{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check the premises
print('Unique values in sex:', df['sex'].unique())
print('Unique values in arm:', df['arm'].unique())
print('Unique values in site:', df['site'].unique())

print('\nNumber of unique patient_id:', df['patient_id'].nunique())
print('Total rows:', len(df))
print('Duplicate patient_id count:', len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check sentinel values
print('\nCount of biomarker_baseline == -999:', (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check assay_batch unit issue
print('\nUnique assay_batch:', df['assay_batch'].unique())
print('Batch B values (should be divided by 10):', df[df['assay_batch'] == 'B']['biomarker_final'].describe())
print('Batch A values:', df[df['assay_batch'] == 'A']['biomarker_final'].describe())"}
